sloka: पुनः आकाशम् आविश्य स्वान् लोकान् प्रतिपेदिरे ।मुमुदे मुदितो लोकः तेन तोयेन भास्वता ॥१-४३-२८॥
transliteration: punaḥ ākāśam āviśya svān lokān pratipedire ।mumude mudito lokaḥ tena toyena bhāsvatā ॥1-43-28॥

translations.english: Cleansed of their sins by the sparkling waters, they ascended through the sky once again to their own (celestial) worlds.
